subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat add only Copy and Select Copy first, or should the first implementation also include Share and Reply actions from the original request?
rationale: Current main clearly lacks the requested affordance, but Share and Reply add product behavior beyond basic text reuse and prior PR reviews found reply-context pitfalls.

options.title: Approve Copy and Select Copy first
options.body: Land a focused action sheet or dialog for text reuse, leaving Share and Reply for a follow-up after the base interaction is proven.

options.title: Approve all four actions
options.body: Treat Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply as one Android UX feature and require the implementation to prove reply context, link tapping, and scroll behavior together.

options.title: Defer the Android-specific action menu
options.body: Keep current code-block selection and revisit message-level actions only after a broader mobile chat interaction design pass.

recommendation.title: Approve Copy and Select Copy first
recommendation.body: Land a focused action sheet or dialog for text reuse, leaving Share and Reply for a follow-up after the base interaction is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete recently merged adjacent Android markdown behavior and has the clearest history signal for product/merge decisions on this chat renderer.
